reviews.title: Good quality product

reviews.title: Missing pieces
reviews.body: My desk arrived missing two pieces. Unfortunately, customer service informed me that they could not simply send the missing parts and that I would need to return the entire desk, which was disappointing.Additionally, the two desktop sections do not fit together seamlessly. There is a noticeable gap on the right side where the pieces meet, making it obvious that the desktop is not a single continuous surface.That said, the desk does have several positives. It looks nice, fits the space I purchased it for, and the electronic lift system works well. The desk raises and lowers smoothly, and the preset height settings are a convenient feature. Assembly was straightforward and easy to follow.Overall, the desk feels reasonably stable for normal office use, though I would not place anything particularly heavy on it or lean significant body weight against it. Despite the issues with the missing parts and desktop fitment, the desk is functional and serves its intended purpose.

reviews.author: J. G. Smith

reviews.title: Great desk!
reviews.body: It is relatively easy to assemble on your own, it will take about 30 minutes to an hour to assemble depending on if you have your own screwdrivers and allen wrenches, which will speed up your setup time as the provided mini tools do the job but aren't as useful/quick as full size versions. Some parts I'd recommend having a second person for, especially when you connect the wooden pieces, just to make sure you get everything tight and flush.The shelf add on is neat but screws on from underneath the desk only, so it essentially clamps around the top edge of the desk, and due to this it is a bit wobbly depending on what you put the shelf, but it is well made and will hold whatever you put on it within its weight limit. However, due to the lack of sturdiness, I would not advise putting something on the shelf that could fall off it if the desk is bumped hard, from shuffling around and whatnot. For example, it holds my monitor just fine. Later on when shuffling my setup around I tried putting my pc with a mAtx case on the shelf, but it was wobbly and I had to put an object underneath the shelf to stabilize it in case I bumped the desk.  For reference a Funko Pop fits perfectly underneath the shelf!The only downside to the desk which isn't the fault of the desk, is that the metal framework is close to the edge the desk, enough that most mounting clamps for monitors and such didn't quite have enough room to clamp onto the desk. Luckily, I used my monitor mount on the corner part, which has a lot more space along its back edge. You may be able to get away with a monitor mount on the other edges of the desk if you use a drill/clamp attachment instead or possibly if your mount has smaller underside clamp pieces. Other than that to only thing I would purchase additionally if you buy the desk is some cord control clips/straps, as the back of the desk is very obviously open and it can look very un-organized without them.The extras are also very nice. The small storage attachment is very functional and can hold a variety of items for easy of access. Easily holding my extra cables, electronics manuals, flash drives etc. The desk also comes with a hook for a headset and several high strength magnets for attaching various knickknacks to the desk.Overall, the desk itself is great. Doesn't creak, feels very sturdy, and walnut coloring I got mine in looks very nice.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 11, 2021

reviews.title: Sturdy and good quality for the price
reviews.body: I love this desk. It's the perfect size for me to put one large monitor in the center, my two laptops on either side. I can either use the preset three phases of height or I can set my own. I use it either sitting in my chair or fully raised with my walking pad. It's not super fancy, but it works well and it was very affordable.

features: Smooth Electric Height Adjustment for All-Day Comfort: Effortlessly switch between sitting and standing with this electric height adjustable desk. Featuring a smooth lifting range from 28.3" to 46.5", it helps promote better posture, reduce fatigue, and keep your energy flowing throughout the day. Perfect for home offices, gaming setups, and productive workspaces.

Spacious & Practical Desktop for Everyday Use:The desktop provides ample space for dual monitors, laptops, and daily essentials. The smooth surface and rounded edges create a comfortable and user-friendly workspace, suitable for both work and gaming setups.

Heavy-Duty Steel Frame with Exceptional Stability:Built with an industrial-grade steel frame, this adjustable desk supports up to 176 lbs with outstanding stability—even at full height. Tested for up to 100,000 lift cycles, it ensures reliable performance for years of daily use.

Powerful Quiet Motor with 3 Memory Presets:Equipped with a high-performance motor operating under 45 dB, this standing desk ensures smooth and quiet transitions. Save up to 3 preferred height settings and return to your ideal position instantly with a single touch.

Safe Materials & Easy Assembly:Made with low-VOC materials to support a healthier indoor environment. Designed for quick and hassle-free setup, this standing desk comes with clear instructions and all necessary tools to get you up and running in no time.
